verdict.rationale: Grafana's own docs give indirect openness signals. Its OpenTelemetry-based collection is described as 'protecting you from vendor lock-in and ensuring data portability.' Dashboards, data sources and other configurations can be defined as version-controlled files. Self-hosted Loki stores log chunks in your own object store or local filesystem. However, nothing documents an actual 'export all my data' function or the open formats it would produce. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of dashboards, alerts and telemetry data, the export formats, a Grafana Cloud exit/offboarding path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
